title: refactor: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-auto-rollback-engine-and-e2e-tests
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Refactor auto-rollback engine to support conditional weighted canaries across canary/A-B/shadow modes; adds e2e stability tests and improves rollback observability. No customer-facing API changes.
description: Background: our existing autorollback engine handled basic canary and shadow flows but had duplicated logic across canary/A-B/shadow paths which made it hard to add new metric quorum/weighted policies and contributed to a post-deploy flake (incident INC-2026-02) where rollback decision latency exceeded SLO. This PR refactors the autorollback engine into a single decision pipeline that supports conditional weighting, metric quorum, and staged probing, and wires end-to-end tests and improved telemetry. What changed: 1) Introduced rollout/rollback core pipeline that normalizes inputs from canary, A/B and shadow routes into a single decision model that can apply weighted thresholds and quorum logic. 2) Replaced duplicated decision code with a small strategy interface and three concrete strategies (canary, ab, shadow) that share evaluation and throttling logic. 3) Added a probe scheduler that performs staged probing and quarantines variants failing preflight checks. 4) Extended observation: emit detailed per-decision telemetry (rollout.decision.latency, rollout.decision.reason, rollout.quarantine.count, rollout.probe.failures) and preflight traces. 5) Brought back deterministic e2e tests that run in perf-canary harness with simulated metrics to validate rollback triggers for latency, error-rate and semantic-quality regressions. 6) Minor ops: config knobs for weight ramping, probe timeout and metric quorum thresholds. Motivation: reduce code complexity, make future policies (composite metrics, multi-metric quorums) easy to add, and fix the latency flake. Testing: unit tests for strategy implementations, integration tests for the pipeline, and new e2e scenarios covering: simple canary rollback on error-rate spike; weighted A/B rollback when composite score drops; shadow quarantine when semantic-quality regression detected. CI: new test groups added to pipeline. Impact: backwards-compatible for rollout config; existing customers see same API surface but can opt into new weighted policies via rollout config. Ops: added runbook notes and dashboard links for rollout telemetry.
